stem: Students make a table of renewable and nonrenewable resources. Which table correctly identifies resources as renewable or nonrenewable?

options.label: A
options.text:
Renewable | Nonrenewable
Water    | Coal
Wood     | Solar

options.label: B
options.text:
Renewable | Nonrenewable
Wind     | Minerals
Water    | Oil

options.label: C
options.text:
Renewable | Nonrenewable
Coal     | Water
Natural Gas | Minerals

options.label: D
options.text:
Renewable | Nonrenewable
Wood     | Wind
Water    | Oil

visual_elements: Table A: Renewable - Water, Wood; Nonrenewable - Coal, Solar
Table B: Renewable - Wind, Water; Nonrenewable - Minerals, Oil
Table C: Renewable - Coal, Natural Gas; Nonrenewable - Water, Minerals
Table D: Renewable - Wood, Water; Nonrenewable - Wind, Oil
